slides.heading: Design Fundamentals 4/4
slides.subtitle: Topics 19–24
slides.narration: Design fundamentals, part 4 of 4. We'll cover Rate limiting, Logging and monitoring, Publish or subscribe pattern, MapReduce, Security and HTTPS, and API design.

slides.heading: 19. Rate limiting
bullets: Token bucket, leaky bucket, fixed/sliding window
a shared store such as Redis
slides.narration: Rate limiting. Token bucket, leaky bucket, fixed or sliding window. per user or IP or region. a shared store such as Redis. DoS protection.

slides.heading: 20. Logging and monitoring
bullets: Structured logs, metrics (time-series), dashboards, alerts on SLOs, tracing
slides.narration: Logging and monitoring. Structured logs, metrics (time-series), dashboards, alerts on SLOs, tracing.

slides.heading: 21. Publish/subscribe pattern
slides.narration: Publish or subscribe pattern. Topics, publishers, subscribers. at-least-once delivery means idempotent consumers. ordering per partition. Kafka, Pub or Sub.

slides.heading: 22. MapReduce
bullets: Map → shuffle → reduce over a distributed file system
data stays where it is and the code moves to it
slides.narration: MapReduce. Map to shuffle to reduce over a distributed file system. idempotent tasks. data stays where it is and the code moves to it.

slides.heading: 23. Security and HTTPS
bullets: Symmetric/asymmetric encryption, TLS handshake, certificates and CAs, MITM
slides.narration: Security and HTTPS. Symmetric or asymmetric encryption, TLS handshake, certificates and CAs, MITM.

slides.heading: 24. API design
bullets: pagination, versioning, idempotency keys, rate limits, clear errors
slides.narration: API design. Resource-oriented REST or RPC or GraphQL. pagination, versioning, idempotency keys, rate limits, clear errors.

slides.heading: Recap
slides.narration: To recap this part: Rate limiting; Logging and monitoring; Publish or subscribe pattern; MapReduce; Security and HTTPS; API design. Each of these shows up again in the design walkthroughs.
